capture.method: Memory-mapped full binary raw; every original vector retained; no interpolation/decimation

interpretation: Simultaneous original native voltages/currents and complete under-margin samples. Correlation is diagnostic evidence, not proof that a particular edit fixes the circuit.

transfer_paths.matching_rule: one same-direction confirmed crossing before the next source transition and within125ps; missing/ambiguous and outside events retained

a_to_c.interpretation: Observed crossing correspondence with pipeline expected-sequence lag recorded; not an acceptance gate.

b_to_d.interpretation: Observed crossing correspondence with pipeline expected-sequence lag recorded; not an acceptance gate.
